reviews.title: I wouldn’t get this app.
reviews.text: I was so exited when I saw this storage cleaner on my App Store, as soon as I got it I decided to open it and try to use it. The first thing this app hits me with is BUY A SUBSCRIPTION, or some like that. What I trying to say is the description I read of THIS app said that this was FREE. To get this app I had to delete a bunch of my other favorite apps and photos. So why did I even bother getting this anyways..? After that annoying inconvenience, I decided to delete the app. Oh, and I forgot to mention, some of my FAVORITE photos were about to get deleted from this app, like the ones of my old dog before he passed away and stuff like, that. Developers, please fix this app! After this experience, I know to NEVER use a storage cleaner again! 😢😠
